The '''''Spiteful''''' was a [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] owned by [[Nebula Consumables]] and [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Seprine]].<ref name="PSG" />

==History==
Under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Seprine]] and her crew, the ''Spiteful'' made runs to exclusive markets in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], carrying mundane and luxury food items as well as more expensive cargoes. During the course of her captaincy, Seprine had romantic relationships with every [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the ''Spiteful''{{'s}} crew, and manipulated each of her lovers until they obeyed and feared her.<ref name="PSG" />
